instruction: Open the 'project' folder located at /home/user/project in VS Code.

command: cd /home/user/Downloads && unzip -q vscodeEvalExtension.zip && code --install-extension vscodeEvalExtension/eval-0.0.1.vsix && rm -rf vscodeEvalExtension vscodeEvalExtension.zip

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses xdotool to read VS Code window title, which reliably reflects the currently open workspace folder.
Window title parsing correctly handles 'workspace - Visual Studio Code' format and extracts the workspace name.
The 'file - folder' format handling (splitting on ' - ' and taking the last segment) correctly extracts the folder name even when a file is open inside the workspace.
Dirty marker ('● ') stripping ensures unsaved-file state does not affect the workspace name comparison.
Metric correctly performs case-insensitive comparison of the extracted workspace name against the expected 'project'.
Negative control resistance is sound: the initial state (no folder open or 'Pictures' folder open) would produce a different workspace_name and fail the check.
Full instruction requirement coverage: the single requirement (open /home/user/project) is fully verified by checking the workspace name equals 'project'.
Accessibility tree fallback provides additional robustness for edge cases where xdotool may not return results.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: The accessibility tree fallback checks for the hardcoded string 'PROJECT' in the full tree text, which is somewhat brittle and could produce false positives if 'PROJECT' appears elsewhere in the UI. Consider using a more targeted accessibility tree query if available.
